meta.name: Glaze UI
meta.principle: Solid where users read or make explicit critical decisions. Glazed where users interact with transient navigation, command, search, control, or feedback chrome.
meta.lineage: One UI 8.5 ergonomics + Liquid Glass hierarchy and fluid material + Material 3 Expressive shape, motion, and adaptive expression + GoreeCloud privacy, identity, accessibility, resilience, and simplicity.
meta.governingSentence: Solid where users read or make explicit critical decisions. Glazed where users interact with transient navigation, command, search, control, or feedback chrome.
meta.signature: ergonomic spatial hierarchy + bounded Glaze Material + connected transformation + adaptive expression + Optical Reachability
meta.compatibilityFoundation: Retained 1.x, GLAZE UI V1.0, and GLAZE UI V1.0 token fields remain compatibility semantics for controlled migration, rollback, and permanent regression validation; new and migrated consumers target GLAZE UI V1.0 Stable.

shape.principle: Use shape to communicate hierarchy and state; expressive geometry is concentrated in high-value or identity-bearing moments rather than applied uniformly.

functionalGlass.usage: legacy 1.x compatibility role for navigation, controls, toolbars, transient chrome; use GLAZE UI V1.0 material levels and System Shell roles for current work

clearGlass.usage: legacy 1.x compatibility role; current work uses 2.2 material hierarchy, accessibility resolution, and bounded System Glaze budgets

material.contentRule: Compatibility rule: legacy 1.x content uses Solid or Raised; current 2.2 durable readable content uses Canvas/Surface while transient interaction uses Soft Glaze/Glaze/Deep Glaze/Live Glaze according to role and Critical System becomes certainty-first and solid.
material.stableRule: Solid where users read or make explicit critical decisions. Glazed where users interact with transient navigation, command, search, control, or feedback chrome.

motion.principle: Retained compatibility timings plus Stable 2.x interaction aliases governed by the current 2.2 contract.

typography.family: system-ui, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.sourcePolicy: Use system/platform-native fonts by default. A locally bundled open-source font may override this stack only when justified and must never require a third-party runtime font service.
typography.principle: Use dramatic hierarchy selectively; preserve readable supporting text and platform-native scaling.

layout.compactReachability: Place frequent actions in the lower interaction zone when composition permits, without changing logical or keyboard order.

mobile.navigation: bottom navigation, compact headers, drawers, sheets, or bounded Capsule/System Overlay patterns
mobile.composition: single-column or intentionally stacked; lower reachability for frequent actions when useful

tablet.primaryInput: touch with optional pointer, keyboard, or stylus
tablet.navigation: navigation rail, side panel, or adaptive navigation suite
tablet.composition: split view, master-detail, contextual pane, larger preview, and posture-aware layout where useful

desktop.primaryInput: pointer and keyboard with touch where available
desktop.navigation: persistent sidebar, toolbar, menus, and shortcuts where useful
desktop.composition: resizable multi-pane workspace with hover, context actions, drag-and-drop, and window-aware layout where useful

tv.primaryInput: directional focus using remote, D-pad, game controller, or keyboard arrows
tv.navigation: simple focus groups and predictable directional paths; no swipe-only or pointer-dependent primary navigation
tv.composition: landscape-first, overscan-safe, large readable content, simple hierarchy, and focus-driven rows or groups
tv.antiPattern: reused phone, tablet, or desktop layout
